title: 2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina Kick Off Party Returns to Miami Design District on October 15
summary: iHeartMedia is a leading global media and entertainment company specializing in radio, digital, mobile, social, live events and on-demand entertainment.
body_markdown:
*Hosted by Enrique Santos and Dayanara Torres, the free event features Tony Succar’s Unity: The Latin Tribute to Michael Jackson with special guest performances by Jean Rodriguez, Anthony Ramos and Howie D*


**WHAT:** iHeartMedia announces the return of the **iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina Kick Off Party,** a free public event taking place at Miami Design District on Thursday, October 15 from 8:00-10:00 p.m. The celebration will serve as the official kickoff to the 2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina main stage event taking place on October 17 at Kaseya Center.


**WHO:** Hosted by **Enrique Santos,** president of iHeartLatino and iHeartRadio personality, and **Dayanara Torres** , co-host of The Enrique Santos Morning Show, the event features **Tony Succar’s Unity: The Latin Tribute to Michael Jackson with special guest performances by Jean Rodriguez, Anthony Ramos and Howie D** of the Backstreet Boys.


The **2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina** main stage event at Kaseya Center on October 17 features performances by **Anuel AA, Myke Towers, Blessd, Farruko, Manuel Turizo, Eladio Carrión, FloyyMenor, Greeicy, Alleh and Rey Tony Y Helabusador “Los Titis.”** Hosted by **Enrique Santos** , this year’s event will also honor **Lin-Manuel Miranda** with the 2026 iHeartRadio Corazón Latino Award.


**WHEN:** iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina Kick Off Party: Thursday, October 15 at 8:00-10:00 p.m.


2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina Main Stage Event: Saturday, October 17 at 8:00 p.m.


**WHERE:**


- **iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina Kick Off Party** (Miami Design District, Jungle Plaza: 3801 NE 1st Avenue, Miami, FL 33137)
- **2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina Main Stage Event** (Kaseya Center: 601 Biscayne Blvd, Miami, FL 33132)


**MORE:** Guests can RSVP to the iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina Kick Off Party[HERE](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/2002636432479?aff=oddtdtcreator) .


Tickets for the 2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina event are available now at[TicketMaster.com](https://www.ticketmaster.com/event/0D0064C58CC07B23) .


Proud partner of the 2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina Kick Off Party is Major Food Group.


Proud partners of the 2026 iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina main stage event include Audible, Boost Mobile, and Goya Foods with more to be announced.


For more information, visit iHeartRadio.com/fiesta.


*Artists and/or event are subject to change or cancellation without notice.*
